review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner, regression design self-review
review.decision: Recheck independent receipt, delivery, and maintenance boundaries against active-proof health
review.notes: Synthetic receipts and transcript fixtures. Query the public health view for the live acknowledgement rather than coupling the existing acceptance test to a historical aggregate marker. Acceptance, exact start and prompt evidence, and workspace completion remain distinct.

cases.description: Accepted native wakes need exact independent turn and prompt evidence
cases.setup: Inject a native receiver acknowledgement after a maintenance reservation and, separately, a fake transcript observation ordered around expected attempt time. Include a different prompt in an existing active turn.
cases.action: Accept a batch, run observation without evidence, then supply its exact turn and prompt transcript evidence. Run again across a simulated reboot.
cases.expected: Acceptance alone neither starts nor confirms delivery. An exact prompt in the acknowledged newly-started turn records both independent observations once. An unrelated turn, an unproven prompt, and authorizing an automatic replay remain excluded. The health view lists a live acknowledgement after its grace period and clears that missing-proof issue after the exact receipt settles.

cases.description: Codex wake witness pairs an exact prompt with its turn after the request
cases.setup: Synthetic transcript tails with exact and mismatched batch text, a different turn ID, and an older active turn before an input attempt.
cases.action: Read the bounded transcript evidence for an expected turn and saved wake payload.
cases.expected: An old or unrelated turn cannot establish wake delivery or new start. The exact matching composite yields timestamps without waiving a pending workspace obligation.
